newsitem.title: CHINA: First Shanghai interested in Yaohan's Whimsy stake.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai interested in Yaohan's Whimsy stake.

text.p: Yaohan International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that First Shanghai Investments Ltd and several other parties were interested in buying part or all of its Whimsy Entertainment Co Ltd stake.

Yaohan International said in a statement it recently had recently been approached by several potential buyers including First Shanghai, interested in acquiring part or whole of its 35.23 percent stake in Whimsy, an amusement centre operator.

"The board is currently considering these opportunities and has not decided whether or not to proceed with the negotiations and with which potential buyer and so far no agreements have been reached," the department store operator added.
First Shanghai is involved in share investment and stockbroking, general insurance, finance, deposit-taking and banking services.

Trading in shares of Yaohan International and Whimsy was expected to resume on Wednesday after being suspended on Tuesday pending the announcement. Yaohan International last traded at HK$0.75 and Whimsy at HK$1.80.
